messages:
Priya (sales): Team, Horizon Dynamics sent an RFI focused on deployment topology + POC pricing. They want a one-page capability matrix that compares Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private, plus explicit answers on HSM support, cert rotation, and whether we can do cross-account KMS. Can we assemble a buyer-friendly response by tomorrow morning?
Liam (solutions): I can do the matrix. Quick clarifying Q: Horizon calls out 'live DR' with <1 min failover. We can commit to sub-60s failover for same-region Dedicated pools via health-check + instance replacement, but cross-region might need warm standby.
Noah (infra): Correct. For cross-region, recommend active-primary in primary region and hot-standby in secondary with automated DNS failover. Achievable ~45-120s depending on DNS TTL and connection drain. For Private on-prem, failover depends on their network.
Olivia (security): HSM: we support BYOK and HSM-backed keys for Dedicated and Private deployments. Hosted uses envelope encryption with Redwood-managed root; customers can opt into hosted KMS but not a customer HSM. We support cross-account KMS grants for Dedicated with IAM role-based access.
Priya (sales): Good. Also Horizon asked about audit log retention and SIEM integration. What do we offer?
Olivia (security): Audit logs available for all tiers. Hosted retains 90 days by default; Dedicated and Private can be configured up to 7 years if desired. Logs exportable to S3, GCS, Splunk, or via webhook to customer SIEM. SOC2 status: we are SOC2 Type II, and FedRAMP prep is underway (in 3rd party assessment).
Liam (solutions): POC pricing options I'd propose:
- Quick eval (hosted, throttled): free credits $2k, 2 weeks
- Dedicated short POC: 2x A10 GPUs for 2 weeks, $6k flat + usage
- Full POC (3 months): reserved discounted rate with 15% off and engineering runbook included
Noah (infra): Network checklist: allowlist outbound to our control plane, open SSH for the Dedicated cluster bootstrap (temporary), and optional private peering. We'll provide a NAT/static egress IP manifest. Horizon needs to confirm whether they'll accept peering or require internet egress.
Priya (sales): Add a line about our recommended playbook: 1) Kickoff + scope dataset, 2) Network & IAM checklist, 3) POC deploy + smoke tests, 4) Perf runs & eval scripts, 5) Wrap-up & handoff.
docs-bot: build:rfp-docs succeeded (sha: f56d9e)
Liam (solutions): Also include a sample snippet for pre-warming KV cache using our prefill API: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/prefill -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -d '{"model":"rwd-13b","prompts":["..." ]}'`
Olivia (security): Add explicit response to their RFI Q7: 'Do you allow customer-managed HSM keys?' Answer: 'Yes for Dedicated and Private; Hosted offers envelope encryption with Redwood-managed root and customer KMS integration for secrets.'
Priya (sales): Perfect. Liam — can you attach the XLSX matrix as horizon_rfi_matrix_v1.xlsx when you post? Aim to finalize tonight so I can send in AM.
Liam (solutions): Uploading draft now. I'll send to Olivia + Noah for a 30-min review.
Noah (infra): I'll double-check the failover RTO numbers. If Horizon insists on active-active across regions with sub-30s, that's a potential blocker. Flagging now.
Priya (sales): Noted. We'll state recommended architecture and call out active-active cross-continent as a limitation.
Liam (solutions): On it. Draft to follow in 45 min.
